name: Trend Following
market_conditions: uptrend with higher highs and higher lows
downtrend with lower highs and lower lows
price above 50 EMA and 200 EMA for longs
price below 50 EMA and 200 EMA for shorts
phase_requirements: not in distribution or accumulation phase
entry_conditions: price pulls back to 20 EMA or 50 EMA in an uptrend
price rallies to 20 EMA or 50 EMA in a downtrend
pullback is orderly with declining volume
structure of higher highs and higher lows remains intact for longs
structure of lower highs and lower lows remains intact for shorts
confirmation_requirements: bullish reversal candle at pullback level for longs
bearish reversal candle at rally level for shorts
RSI bouncing from 40-50 zone in uptrend
RSI rejecting from 50-60 zone in downtrend
price closes back above pullback EMA for longs
price closes back below rally EMA for shorts
stop_loss_logic: Place stop loss below the most recent higher low for longs; above the most recent lower high for shorts. Add 0.5-1 ATR buffer beyond the swing point to avoid premature stop-out.
take_profit_logic: Target the next swing high for longs or next swing low for shorts. Use partial exits at 1:1 RR and trail remaining position using a 20 EMA trail. Final target at measured move projection from the base of the trend leg.
invalidation_conditions: price breaks below the last higher low for longs
price breaks above the last lower high for shorts
trend structure shifts from higher highs/higher lows to lower highs/lower lows
price closes below 200 EMA on daily chart for longs
ADX drops below 20 indicating trend exhaustion
major divergence on MACD or RSI without confirmation

required_features.ema_alignment: price above EMA20 above EMA50 above EMA200 for longs

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1D or 1W to identify primary trend direction
timeframe_requirements.entry: 4H or 1H for pullback confirmation and entry trigger

risk_notes: Risk 1-2% per trade. Avoid entering during the final blow-off phase of a trend. Do not chase entries; wait for the pullback. Be cautious near major resistance for longs or major support for shorts. Trend following has a lower win rate but high RR; account for this in position sizing.

agent_rules.rule: Never enter a trend-following trade against the 200 EMA direction on the daily chart.
Wait for the pullback candle to show a reversal signal before entering; do not buy into a falling pullback.
If ADX is below 20, do not apply trend-following strategy; switch to range-trading.
Always confirm the higher low structure is intact before entry. One break of structure invalidates the setup.
Scale out 50% at 1:1 RR, move stop to breakeven, and trail the rest.
